sources.title: BLURR: A Boosted Low-Resource Inference for Vision-Language-Action Model
sources.snippet: Figure 2. High-level comparison of the Interleave-Pi-0 (interleavevla) baseline and our BLURR-Pi-0 inference stack. In (a), RGB images and language instructions are jointly encoded by a pre-trained vision–language model and decoded into actions over a 10-step control rollout using an FP32 action decoder without caching or compilation.
